newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end up, Deutsche Telekom falls flat.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end up, Deutsche Telekom falls flat.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed higher on Tuesday, after fluctuating in no particular direction amid light trading volume. Shares of newly listed Deutsche Telekom traded in heavy volume, but they closed lower than the initial price and failed to inspire.
The key Nikkei 225 average gained 159.81 points or 0.77 percent to 20,956.18. Its December futures rose 190 points to 20.990.
"Market sentiment did not change, even while the Nikkei jumped or dropped," said Keiji Arai, strategist at Sanyo Securities Co Ltd.
